objective: Complete the route/theme boundary slice with scoped division shells for gateway, Systems, and Studio.

criteria.promise: Gateway, Systems, and Studio route groups each render a scoped division shell with an independent data boundary and theme variables.
The three public division layouts preserve the six direct routes and keep the private admin route outside public division shells.
Focused theme-boundary tests and the existing route tests prove the boundary contract while preserving all foundation gates.

verification_gates.procedure: Read the three route-group layouts and globals.css; run npm test to exercise the shell assertions.
verification_gates.expected: Each public division has its own layout data boundary, and CSS contains separate gateway, systems, and studio variable scopes.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect the App Router tree and run npm run build to enumerate routes; read app/admin/page.tsx and the new layouts.
verification_gates.expected: The six direct routes remain present, the three public shells are distinct, and admin is not nested in a public division layout.

verification_gates.procedure: From starter, run npm.cmd run lint; npm.cmd run typecheck; npm.cmd test; npm.cmd run build; npm.cmd run cf:build.
verification_gates.expected: All five commands exit 0, theme-boundary tests pass, and the six direct routes remain buildable.

first_checkpoint.evidence: Three route-group layouts, independent CSS scopes, and a focused theme-boundary test scaffold.
